input.find:
for i, l := range b.lines {
			leftover := util.CharacterCount(bytes.TrimRightFunc(l.data, unicode.IsSpace))

			linelen := util.CharacterCount(l.data)
			b.Remove(Loc{leftover, i}, Loc{linelen, i})
input.replace:
for i := range b.lines {
			l := b.lines[i]
			leftover := util.CharacterCount(bytes.TrimRightFunc(l.data, unicode.IsSpace))

			linelen := util.CharacterCount(l.data)
			b.Remove(Loc{leftover, i}, Loc{linelen, i})
